description: A volunteer foot soldier in the supplied pixel art style. A brown cap with a maroon headband, grey lamellar armor, a maroon sash, brown trousers and boots. A round wooden shield with an iron boss on the left arm and a long spear in the right hand
face: A plain determined face with a short moustache.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the brown cap and maroon headband tails, grey armor, the round shield on his left arm, the spear at his right side.
guard_action: the shield comes up in front of the body on the left arm, the spear is held ready at the right side, the left foot steps forward

actions.idle: Shield-and-spear guard, shield in front on the left arm, spear in the right hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place with shield and spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: SHIELD BASH. The spear stays upright at the side. Frames 3-6 the shield is pulled in to the chest and he crouches; frame 7 one step forward; frame 8 the shield is rammed forward with the whole body; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b2: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the upper body winds far to the right, shield turning with it; frames 7-8 the spear swings around level from the side to the front; frames 9-11 hold in front. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Overhand spear stab. Frames 1-5 the spear is lifted above the right shoulder; frame 8 it is driven down over the top of the shield; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Steadfast defence. Frames 1-6 the shield is drawn square in front of the body, knees and hips sink, the spear stands upright at the side; frame 8 he locks the stance; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c6: Turning thrust. The body turns once on the spot behind the shield and comes out of the turn into a straight thrust, point first; the reach is held behind the shield.
actions.b3: RISING spear strike. Frames 3-6 the spear tip drops low in front; frames 7-8 it scoops up from below through the target; frame 9 it finishes high; frames 10-11 hold.
actions.c4: Leaping downward thrust. He crouches behind the shield, jumps, and drives the spear straight down on the target as he lands; a short hold low behind the shield.
actions.pb1: SHIELD BASH. The spear stays upright at the side. Frames 3-6 the shield is pulled in to the chest and he crouches; frame 7 one step forward; frame 8 the shield is rammed forward with the whole body; frames 9-11 hold.
actions.pb2: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the upper body winds far to the right, shield turning with it; frames 7-8 the spear swings around level from the side to the front; frames 9-11 hold in front.
actions.pa3: Overhand spear stab. Frames 1-5 the spear is lifted above the right shoulder; frame 8 it is driven down over the top of the shield; frames 9-11 hold.
actions.ps1: Steadfast defence. Frames 1-6 the shield is drawn square in front of the body, knees and hips sink, the spear stands upright at the side; frame 8 he locks the stance; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck.
